NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 23, 10:21 AM ET

The Texans are the top-projected defense on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 8.4 DraftKings points for $3,400, against the Giants. Vikings (7.2, $3,500) and Broncos (7.1, $3,300) are next.

The Texans are also the top value at the position: 2.49 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 23, 10:21 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 7

Texans, HOU vs NYG ($3,400)

Texans carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.4 DraftKings points at $3,400. That is 1.3 points clear of Vikings. The salary works out to 2.49 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 7 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Texans averaged 8.6 points with a simulated floor of -0.8 and a ceiling of 15.1, and it holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Houston is a 10.5-point favorite at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 26.5 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Titans, TEN vs CLE ($2,600)

Titans projects for 6.4 DraftKings points at $2,600, which works out to 2.45 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 7 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 100,000 simulations Titans averaged 6.5 points with a simulated floor of -0.9 and a ceiling of 15.8, and it holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tennessee is a 1.5-point underdog at home against Cleveland, with an implied team total of 18 in a game totaled at 37.5.
